meta.title: A Dutch price direction that contradicts the order type is refused
gaps: The available vocabulary does not provide fields or an operation to set the auction order type to Dutch or set an end price below the base price.
The refusal message naming the prices cannot be asserted because no response-message assertion field is provided.

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and an auction round attached, not published.
steps: As the buyer, read the event and check that the event is still a draft (not published).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with a clear message, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the event is still a draft (not published).

plan.title: A Dutch price direction that contradicts the order type is refused

assert.say: the event is still a draft (not published)
